cues.en: Some
people say a man is made out of mud.
A poor man's made out of muscle and blood.
cues.zh: 穷人的身体是由肌肉和血液构成的。

cues.en: Muscle and blood and skin and bones,
a mind that's weak and a back that's strong, you load 16 tons.
cues.zh: 你装十六吨煤，意志薄弱，脊背却强壮。

cues.en: What do you get?
Another day older and deeper and depth. Saint Peter, don't you call me because I can go.
cues.zh: 又老了一天，债务也陷得更深，圣彼得，别召唤我，因为我脱不开身。

cues.en: I owe my soul to the company store.
cues.zh: 我把灵魂都典当给了公司。

cues.en: I
was born one morning when the sun didn't shine.
cues.zh: 出生在一个没有阳光的清晨。

cues.en: I picked up my shovel and I walked to the mine. I loaded 16 tons, a number nine cold, and a straw boss said, well, to bless my soul, you load 16
cues.zh: 我拿起铁锹，走向矿井。我装了16吨，9号冷煤，一个工头说，哎呀，保佑我的灵魂，你装了16

cues.en: tons.
What do you get?
Another day older and deeper in death. Saint Peter, don't you call me because I can't go. I owe my soul to the company store.
cues.zh: 又老了一天，离死亡更近一步。圣彼得，别叫我，因为我走不了。我把灵魂欠给了公司商店。

cues.en: Was born one morning. It was drizzling rain.
cues.zh: 某个早晨出生，当时下着毛毛雨。

cues.en: Fighting and trouble are my middle name. I was raised in the cane break by an old mama lion. Can't go a high toned woman. Make me walk the line. You load 16 tons.
cues.zh: 争斗和麻烦是我的中间名。我是在甘蔗丛里被一只老母狮养大的。受不了高贵女人，逼我循规蹈矩。你装十六吨。

cues.en: What do you get?
Another day older and deeper in-depth. Saint Peter, don't you call me because I can't go. I owe my soul to the company store.
cues.zh: 又老了一天，陷得更深。圣彼得，别叫我，因为我走不了。我把灵魂欠给了公司商店。

cues.en: If
you see me coming better, step aside.
cues.zh: 你看到我走来，最好让开。

cues.en: A lot of men didn't. A lot of men died. One fist of iron,
cues.zh: 很多男人没让开。很多男人死了。一只铁拳，

cues.en: the other of steel. If the right one don't get you, then the left one will. You load 16
cues.zh: 另一只钢拳。右拳打不倒你，左拳也会打倒你。你装上16

cues.en: tons.
What do you get?
Another day older and deeper in-depth. Saint Peter, don't you call me because I can go.
cues.zh: 又老了一天，陷得更深。圣彼得，别叫我，我还不能走。

cues.en: I owe
my
soul
to the company store.
